# Tuning Guide

Spark configuration spans cluster-level defaults and per-session overrides. Understanding which layer wins prevents most misconfiguration bugs.

## Memory Tuning

Executor memory is split between execution and storage. When unified memory management is enabled, both regions borrow from a shared pool and evict cached blocks under pressure.

```python
spark.conf.set("spark.memory.fraction", "0.6")
spark.conf.get("spark.executor.memory")
```

Set memory overhead for off-heap allocations such as netty buffers and JVM metaspace; undersized overhead is the classic container-kill failure mode.

## Partitioning

Shuffle partitions default to two hundred regardless of data size. Scan-heavy jobs benefit from sizing partitions near one hundred megabytes each, while skew requires salting hot keys before the shuffle boundary.

| Setting | Default | Tuned |
| --- | --- | --- |
| shuffle.partitions | 200 | 2-4x cores |
| memory.fraction | 0.6 | 0.5-0.7 |

AQE coalesces post-shuffle partitions automatically when enabled, which usually removes the need for manual tuning on ad-hoc workloads.
